shared_elements: animal in profile relief (quadruped/reptile on A; bird and animal signs among B's hieroglyphs)
low-relief carving on a flat upright slab face
human figures in profile (B only, though A's pillar type is anthropomorphic in form)
justification: Both show shallow relief on an upright slab and both include profile animal imagery, but that is generic; A carries a single large isolated reptilian creature on an otherwise blank field, while B is densely packed with registers of seated/standing human figures facing offering tables and columns of small standardized signs. There is no shared relationship, register scheme or figural convention beyond the universal use of profile animal outlines.
